Eligibility is the 2026-11-21 research snapshot; review counts are not updated live. Refresh sources when businesses open, close, move, or cross the threshold.
cstat-eats._tiers: Estimate name recognition for TAMU students, not restaurant quality or distance from campus. Plankton: household chains and flagship student staples.
